summary: Russian forces launched coordinated strikes on Odesa and Zaporizhzhia causing civilian casualties, while a massive wave of jet-powered UAVs, Shahed-136/Geran-5 drones, and cruise missiles targeted at least 10 Ukrainian oblasts overnight. Ukrainian Neptune missiles struck drone production facilities and storage sites in Rostov-on-Don. Russian troops advanced near Rusyn Yar on the eastern front.
key_points: Russian strikes on Odesa killed 2 and injured 7; Zaporizhzhia attack killed a 17-year-old and wounded 13 including 5 children. (Source: @UkraineNow/85282)

Massive overnight drone/missile wave: jet UAVs, Shaheds, Geran-5, and Bandrel cruise missiles detected across Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv, Kyiv, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Dnipropetrovsk, Kirovohrad, Poltava, Sumy, Kharkiv, Zaporizhzhia. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78195)
Ukrainian Neptune missiles hit tactical UAV production (IONOS), storage, and Aero-Hit service center repairing Veles FPV drones in Rostov-on-Don. (Source: @UkraineNow/85283)
DeepState map confirms Russian advance near Rusyn Yar on eastern front. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24001)
Russian guided aerial bombs (KABs) struck Zaporizhzhia and Kharkiv oblasts. (Source: @kpszsu/95850)
Swedish PM Kristersson opposes EU opt-outs on Ukraine funding, supports frozen Russian assets use, warns against separate talks with Moscow. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24000)
US bipartisan group (105 House members) demands Trump restore Ukraine's full Starshield access amid new restrictions. (Source: @UkraineNow/85279)
Poland refuses to fund US weapons purchases for Ukraine citing resource constraints and own defense needs. (Source: @UkraineNow/85291)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces launched coordinated strikes on Odesa and Zaporizhzhia causing civilian casualties, while a massive wave of jet-powered UAVs, Shahed-136/Geran-5 drones, and cruise missiles targeted at least 10 Ukrainian oblasts overnight. Ukrainian Neptune missiles struck drone production facilities and storage sites in Rostov-on-Don. Russian troops advanced near Rusyn Yar on the eastern front.

points: Ukrainian Navy launched Neptune anti-ship missiles against drone manufacturing and storage facilities in Rostov-on-Don, hitting IONOS tactical UAV production, finished product warehouses, and Aero-Hit service center repairing Veles FPV drones for frontline use. (Source: @UkraineNow/85283)

Volunteer network eRadar delivered thermal imaging sight DEFENDER for NGU anti-aircraft artillery unit covering capital region, drone detector for Police Special Purpose Regiment on Pokrovsk axis, and monitors for command post of a ZSU unit on northern front. (Source: @eRadarrua/130523)
eRadar fundraising campaign seeks charging station for 23rd Brigade drone battalion, continuing record-speed collections from audience. (Source: @eRadarrua/130535)

Ukrainian air defense engaged multiple incoming Russian drones and missiles across at least 10 oblasts overnight, with monitoring channels reporting interceptions and tracking. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78195)

Russian forces struck Odesa with missiles/drones killing 2 civilians and injuring 7; separate attack on Zaporizhzhia killed a 17-year-old and wounded 13 including 5 children. (Source: @UkraineNow/85282)

Massive overnight launch of jet-powered UAVs (реактивний БпЛА), Shahed-136/Geran-5 loitering munitions, and Bandrel cruise missiles from multiple vectors: Bryansk, Kursk, Chernihiv, Black Sea, occupied territories targeting Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Kirovohrad, Dnipropetrovsk, Poltava, Sumy, Kharkiv, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Zaporizhzhia. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78195)
Russian tactical aviation employed guided aerial bombs (KABs) against Zaporizhzhia and Kharkiv oblasts. (Source: @kpszsu/95850)

Russian low-orbit satellite constellation 'Rassvet' (Starlink analog) faces delays: only 30 satellites deployed, none reached planned 800 km altitude, two deorbited, third launch cancelled/postponed to 2026. (Source: @UkraineNow/85286)
Russian drones detected over RAF Lakenheath (USAF base) in UK, prompting shelter-in-place for personnel; no interception reported. (Source: @eRadarrua/130546)
DeepState map update confirms Russian forces advanced near Rusyn Yar (likely Donetsk/Zaporizhzhia border area). (Source: @DeepStateUA/24001)
Russian guided aerial bombs (KABs) struck targets in Zaporizhzhia and Kharkiv oblasts, indicating continued pressure on eastern front logistics and fortifications. (Source: @kpszsu/95850)

ISW assesses Putin may use temporary local ceasefire in Kostyantynivka to accumulate forces for advance north toward Druzhkivka, a heavily fortified 'Fortress Belt' city; Russians evacuating civilians from controlled parts of Kostyantynivka. (Source: @UkraineNow/85287)
Ukrainian strike drone groups reported east of Kharkiv moving south, suggesting active Ukrainian UAV operations on eastern axis. (Source: @kpszsu/95849)
Multiple Geran-5 missiles launched from Bryansk Oblast toward Chernihiv Oblast (Chernihiv district) and from Chernihiv Oblast toward Kyiv Oblast (Vyshhorod district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78195)
Geran-5 launched from Kursk Oblast toward Sumy Oblast (Sumy district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78195)
Jet-powered UAVs detected from Chernihiv Oblast toward Kyiv reservoir area heading toward Chornobyl zone. (Source: @kpszsu/95821)

Three Geran-5 missiles approached Zhytomyr from Zhytomyr Oblast; one Geran-5 from Chernihiv to Kyiv (Vyshhorod); jet UAV from Kyiv Oblast northward to Zhytomyr Oblast. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78195, @kpszsu/95824)
Russian strikes on Odesa killed 2, injured 7; Zaporizhzhia attack killed 1, injured 13 including 5 children. (Source: @UkraineNow/85282)
Multiple jet-powered UAV groups launched from Black Sea toward Tatarbunary district (Odesa Oblast) and Ochakiv area (Mykolaiv Oblast). (Source: @kpszsu/95854, @kpszsu/95851, @kpszsu/95853)
Jet UAV detected from Black Sea toward Mykolaiv district (Mykolaiv Oblast); another circling near Odesa. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78195, @mon1tor_ua/78201)

Ukrainian Neptune missile strike hit drone production and repair facilities in Rostov-on-Don, degrading Russian FPV and tactical UAV capabilities supporting southern front. (Source: @UkraineNow/85283)

Overnight massive combined raid: at least 3 Geran-5 from Chernihiv to Kyiv (Vyshhorod), 1 Geran-5 from Bryansk to Chernihiv, 1 Geran-5 from Kursk to Sumy, 3 Geran-5 approaching Zhytomyr, 1 Geran-5 on/near Dnipro, multiple jet-powered UAVs (реактивний БпЛА) from Mykolaiv to Kirovohrad (Kropyvnytskyi), from Dnipropetrovsk to Poltava, from Black Sea to Mykolaiv/Odesa border, from Kyiv to Zhytomyr, from Cherkasy to Vinnytsia (Teplik), from Kirovohrad to Vinnytsia (Haisyn), from Vinnytsia to Khmelnytskyi, from Dnipropetrovsk to Kirovohrad (Oleksandriia), from Zhytomyr to Rivne. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78195, @mon1tor_ua/78196, @mon1tor_ua/78205, @kpszsu/95842, @kpszsu/95843, @kpszsu/95846, @kpszsu/95847, @kpszsu/95841, @kpszsu/95839, @kpszsu/95823, @kpszsu/95824)

Two Bandrel cruise missiles launched from Chernihiv Oblast toward Kyiv Oblast; two Bandrel on Kyiv Oblast likely toward Zhytomyr; one Bandrel toward Kremenchuk. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78204, @mon1tor_ua/78203)

Jet UAV detected over Vyshneve heading to Irpin, triggering Kyiv air alert; another on Kryvyi Rih moving toward Mykolaiv; one on Zaporizhzhia from northeast. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78199, @mon1tor_ua/78200, @mon1tor_ua/78206, @kpszsu/95856, @kpszsu/95857)
Russian drones spotted over RAF Lakenheath (UK) used by USAF; personnel ordered to shelter, no kinetic response reported. (Source: @eRadarrua/130546)

Swedish PM Kristersson rejects EU national opt-outs on Ukraine funding, supports frozen Russian assets use, warns separate European talks with Moscow benefit Russia. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24000)

sections.threat_assessment: Russia maintains high-intensity multi-axis drone and missile campaign targeting civilian infrastructure and rear logistics across Ukraine, while advancing locally near Rusyn Yar. Ukrainian Neptune strike on Rostov drone facilities demonstrates growing long-range strike capability against Russian UAV production. Russian 'Rassvet' satellite program setbacks degrade their communications resilience. Continued Russian guided bomb usage on eastern front indicates sustained pressure on fortified positions. Ukrainian air defense faces saturation challenges from diverse threat vectors.
sections.regional_response: Sweden pushes for unified EU financing and frozen asset utilization, opposing Hungarian-style vetoes. US congressional bipartisan pressure mounts on Trump administration to maintain Starshield access for Ukraine. Poland's refusal to fund US weapons transfers signals potential fragmentation in European procurement coordination. Norway extends athlete bans, reinforcing sports sanctions. EU leadership representation for peace talks remains unresolved ahead of Dublin summit.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian drone launch patterns show increased use of jet-powered UAVs (likely Shahed-238 or similar) alongside traditional Shahed-136/Geran-5, complicating air defense. Bandrel cruise missile launches from northern vectors suggest continued stockpile availability. Ukrainian targeting of specific drone production entities (IONOS, Aero-Hit) indicates precise intelligence on Russian UAV supply chain. Russian civilian evacuations from Kostyantynivka corroborate ISW assessment of operational preparation for Druzhkivka advance. FAA nationwide ground stop in US unrelated but highlights aviation system vulnerabilities.
